_comment: Built-in message templates. Placeholders: {name} {service} {professional} {date} {time} {deadline} {minutes} {link}. {date} = weekday + day + month without year, formatted by the locale; {time} per the locale clock; {deadline} = date and time of the free-change limit. Link base comes from BELLO_WEB_BASE_URL. Add the extra kinds listed in docs/07-LOCALIZATION.md section 6 in the same voice.
